Register Now for Fall Recreation Programs! Non-residents can register starting Tuesday, September 8. Children's Dance Toddlers love to groove and beat to the music! Our supportive, affordable and safe programs focus on having fun and teaching age-appropriate dance skills for kids ages 2 to 6. How to register Login or register to your online registration account and find the desired program within the menu. If you need assistance with the process of registering online, call the Program Information Hotline at 905-873-2600, ext. 2275. Kinder Acro: Ages 4-6 An introduction to Acro Dance where participants will learn introductory acro combinations to the latest music. Classes focus on developing strength, flexibility, balance, coordination, and concentration. Children will work towards creating a routine for the final class! Kinder Ballet: Ages 4-6 This class is designed as an introduction to Ballet. During this program, children will learn about the five classic ballet positions and begin to practice basic movements, turns and jumps. While exploring music and creative steps, children will develop coordination, balance and self-confidence. Children will build their skills and work towards creating a dance routine for the final class! Kinder Hip Hop: Ages 4-6 An introduction to Hip Hop Dance where participants will learn introductory hip hop combinations to the latest music. Participants will develop their personal style and rhythm. Children will be taught various types of dance steps and will work towards creating a dance routine for the final class! Tiny Dancers: Ages 2-3 Your child's first dance class! This class is designed to introduce your little one to music and movement through a fun and interactive program. It will focus on gross motor development, coordination, balance and social skills. One adult must participate in the program with the child. Dance Schedule - FALL 2026 Location: GCC = Gellert Community Centre, 10241 8 Line, Georgetown , (905) 877-4244 Children's Dance Schedule - FALL 2026 Program age day loc. time dates fee / # classes code Tiny Dancers 2-3 yrs Sat GCC 8:30 AM - 9:00 AM Sep 26 - Dec 12 $117.00 / 12 Classes 110442 Kinder Ballet 4-6 yrs Sat GCC 9:05 AM -9:50 AM Sep 26 - Dec 12 $138.36 / 12 Classes 110443 Kinder Hip Hop 4-6 yrs Sat GCC 9:55 AM - 10:40 AM Sep 26 - Dec 12 $138.36 / 12 Classes 110444 Kinder Acro 4-6 yrs Sat GCC 10:45 AM -11:30 AM Sep 26 - Dec 12 $138.36 / 12 Classes 110445 Children's Sports Get out and give it a shot! Children's basketball and multi-sport programs teach fundamental skills in a progressive manner while encouraging fair play and a love of the game. How to register Login or register to your online registration account and find the desired program within the menu. If you need assistance with the process of registering online, call the Program Information Hotline at 905-873-2600, ext. 2275. Basketball - Junior & Senior This recreational program focuses on teaching the fundamentals of basketball in a progressive manner while encouraging fair play and a love for the game. This high energy program has been designed to engage players through drills and skills development. Game play will be incorporated at times, however, it will not be the focus of the program. Programs take place at St Catherine of Alexandria school- please enter the building from the front door of the school. Children should wear comfortable active clothing and non-marking running shoes. Please come prepared and ready to start the class and leave promptly after the class finishes. Please bring a full plastic water bottle. Junior/Senior program ages: Junior: 7-9 years old Senior: 10-13 years old Multi-Sports - Junior & Senior Multi-Sport participants are kept moving and engaged, learning a new skill from a different sport each class. Sports include soccer, baseball, basketball , football, floor hockey, volleyball, and badminton. By introducing your child to a variety of sports they will have the opportunity to find out which one feels right for specialization in later years. Programs held at McKenzie Smith Bennett Public School & Georgetown District High School. Children should wear comfortable active clothing and non-marking running shoes. Please come prepared and ready to start the class and leave promptly after the class finishes. Please bring a full plastic water bottle. Browse Service Categories HCSD Training Use Our Search Widgets on your Site Help Contact Us Open Data Project (Oakville) About / FAQs Terms of Use & Privacy Search Tips HCSD Training Login View List ( ) Home Record Details Milton Community Resource Centre Site: Milton - Head Office Service: EarlyON Child and Family Centre Record Added Add to List Suggest Update Print Version (New Window) Record #: MIL0114 Last Full Update: 27 May 2026 Contact Information Office Phone 905-876-1244 E-Mail navigators@mcrc.on.ca Website https://mcrc.on.ca/earlyon/ Contact Form https://mcrc.on.ca/contact/ Social Media Facebook , YouTube , Instagram Primary Contact Jennifer Lee, Supervisor, MCRC EarlyON; Phone: 905-876-1244 ext 2300; Email: jennifer.lee@mcrc.on.ca Alternate Contact Jessica Rankin, Director, Early Years Child and Family Services; Phone: 905-876-1244 ext 254; Email: jessicar@mcrc.on.ca Volunteer Coordinator Heather Bonser, Volunteer Co-ordinator; Phone: 905-876-1244 ext 430; Email: heather.bonser@mcrc.on.ca Agency Information Established 1985 Funding Fundraising ; Donations ; Fees - service ; Ministry of Education Description and Service Details Description (Service) EarlyON Centre offering programs and services to parents, caregivers and children newborn-six years. there are no costs for EarlyON programs provides information on parenting issues and opportunities for parents to share and receive information on positive parenting topics network and find support in a welcoming environment childcare may be available during parenting programs, pre-registration required Adult and Child Play Together Program (Ages 0-6) Adult and Child together Drop-ins gives parents/caregivers and children an opportunity to explore, engage, and express themselves together which helps strengthen the bond between adult and child. There are many creative activities, sensory and early literacy experiences to choose from within the room and a registered Early Childhood Educator in a co-learner role with the adults and children participating. Music and Movement Programs (Ages 0-6) Adults and children can participate in a variety of gross motor activities that stimulate muscle development, balance, flexibility, coordination, language skills, turn taking and social skills all while having lots of fun! This program will include balls, slides, bean bags, hula hoops, tunnels, balance beam, and rocking boats as well as a musical component and circle time. Baby Sing and Connect (Ages 0-12 months) Parents are the first and most powerful influence child’s learning, development, and well-being. This group provides valuable time to connect with your baby as you sing-a-long to songs. This group offers an opportunity to demonstrate and expand on early literacy and language through repetition and memory. An Educator is your partner in this interactive and enjoyable program. Exploring Mother Nature at Mill Pond Outdoor Program (Ages 0-6) This year-round, outdoor Early Years Drop-In program gives adults and children an opportunity to explore and discover the wonders of nature at the beautiful Mill Pond. Parents and caregivers will have a chance to develop language skills with their children while walking around the pond. Children often express themselves in new and different ways when placed in an outdoor environment. Make sure to dress appropriately for the weather. Baby Toddler Play and Connect Program (Ages 0-18 months) Babies and toddlers grow and flourish in a positive age appropriate environment and within the context of healthy relationships. Baby & Toddler Drop-in gives parents/caregivers and children an opportunity to explore, engage, and express themselves together which helps strengthen the bond between adult and child. There are many creative activities, sensory and early literacy experiences to choose from within the room and a registered Early Childhood Educator in a co-learner role with the adults and children participating. EarlyON Parenting Join our educators as we participate in different parenting learning programs weekly. Some program examples are Circle of Security, Restoring Energy and Self-Care, Parenting book club, Self-Regulation, Kindergarten Readiness, Infant Massage, Nobody's Perfect, Introduction to Childcare, Toilet Training Workshops, and Infant Sleep Workshops. See our Parenting Calendars for dates/times. *Please see the EarlyON program schedules for Viola Public School and 410 Bronte Street South locations at website: www.mcrc.on.ca for additional programs Hours Office Hours: Mon, Wed, Fri 9 am-4 pm, Tue 9 am-6 pm, Thu 9 am-4 pm, Sat 9:30 am-12 noon (except long weekends) Dates Check the website for dates/times/locations of specific programs Areas Served Milton Eligibility Ages: 6 year(s) and under Application Some programs require registration which can be done through the website Drop-in programs do not require registration Languages English Fees Program ; No Fees for Programs Site Information Located In Community Milton Address & Map 410 Bronte St S Milton, ON L9T 0H8 View Google Map Intersection Bronte St S and Derry Rd W Physical Access Fully Accessible Categories and Classification HCSD Main Heading Child / Family Services HCSD Sub Heading Parent / Child Programs ; Recreation for Children / Families Service Categories Early Childhood Family Centres ; Infant Massage Instruction ; Parent/Child Activity Groups ; Parent/Child Instruction Agency Overview About This Agency Milton Community Resource Centre A multi-service agency providing programs and services to families in Milton and surrounding communities. 13 Agency Locations [Show Listings] Bronte Street School Milton Community Resource Centre 410 Bronte St S Milton, ON L9T 0H8 View Google Map Campbellville - There are many creative activities, sensory and early literacy experiences to choose from within the room and a registered Early Childhood Educator in a co-learner role with the adults and children participating. Music and Movement Programs (Ages 0-6) Adults and children can participate in a variety of gross motor activities that stimulate muscle development, balance, flexibility, coordination, language skills, turn taking and social skills all while having lots of fun! This program will include balls, slides, bean bags, hula hoops, tunnels, balance beam, and rocking boats as well as a musical component and circle time. Baby Sing and Connect (Ages 0-12 months) Parents are the first and most powerful influence child’s learning, development, and well-being. This group provides valuable time to connect with your baby as you sing-a-long to songs. This group offers an opportunity to demonstrate and expand on early literacy and language through repetition and memory. An Educator is your partner in this interactive and enjoyable program. Exploring Mother Nature at Mill Pond Outdoor Program (Ages 0-6) This year-round, outdoor Early Years Drop-In program gives adults and children an opportunity to explore and discover the wonders of nature at the beautiful Mill Pond. Parents and caregivers will have a chance to develop language skills with their children while walking around the pond. Children often express themselves in new and different ways when placed in an outdoor environment. Make sure to dress appropriately for the weather. Baby Toddler Play and Connect Program (Ages 0-18 months) Babies and toddlers grow and flourish in a positive age appropriate environment and within the context of healthy relationships. Baby & Toddler Drop-in gives parents/caregivers and children an opportunity to explore, engage, and express themselves together which helps strengthen the bond between adult and child. There are many creative activities, sensory and early literacy experiences to choose from within the room and a registered Early Childhood Educator in a co-learner role with the adults and children participating. EarlyON Parenting Join our educators as we participate in different parenting learning programs weekly. Some program examples are Circle of Security, Restoring Energy and Self-Care, Parenting book club, Self-Regulation, Kindergarten Readiness, Infant Massage, Nobody's Perfect, Introduction to Childcare, Toilet Training Workshops, and Infant Sleep Workshops.
